final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro runs a local financial cockpit and Bob pipeline for chart analysis, Deep math/expert review, IBKR paper visibility, paper-trade history, decision tracing, and audited financial answers.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 as the local operator validating Bob before demo, paper-trading use, and monetization.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Start CEO on 8082 and API/UI on 8002, open the browser cockpit, inspect Genie/Chart/Deep/IBKR/Trade History, ask Bob, and review Blame Report for the run_id.
final_objective.start_command: python -m agent_server.main with CEO llama.cpp already listening on 8082
final_objective.proof_output: http://127.0.0.1:8002 renders nonblank chart, Deep column, IBKR Mirror, Paper history rows, and interactive Blame Report.

what_was_done: Gave Deep a proper cockpit column instead of relying on chart-workspace injection.
Exposed and validated broker_orders, local_tickets, trade_history, trade_stats, and /trades/history in the cockpit API contract.
Updated IBKR Mirror UI semantics so real IBKR broker orders are distinct from local pending tickets and PaperJournal history.
Added interactive Blame Report panel that loads /health/trace/{run_id}, shows summary, blockers, slowest nodes, agent stats, and expandable trace events.
Rendered PaperJournal trade history in the cockpit with clickable ticker rows.
Moved the Bob floating panel on desktop so it no longer hides the Deep column or the Mirror/history footer.
Restarted the live FastAPI backend on port 8002 while leaving the CEO llama-server on 8082 running.
